title: Spiced Chickpea Balls in Tangy Tomato Sauce
blurb: Herb-flecked chickpea balls simmered in a sharp tomato sauce with garlic and a touch of heat.
steps: Mash the drained chickpeas in a large bowl until mostly broken down but still with some texture.
Stir in half the chopped onion, half the garlic, the oats, parsley, cumin, half the cayenne, and half the salt until the mixture holds together when pressed.
Shape the mixture into 16 balls, using damp hands to prevent sticking.
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat and fry the chickpea balls for 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden on most sides.
Remove the balls from the pan and set aside, then add the remaining onion and garlic to the same pan and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée, apple cider vinegar, water, remaining cayenne, and remaining salt to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the chickpea balls to the pan, spooning sauce over them, then cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the balls with the sauce spooned over, alongside rice or pasta if you like.
